pages.title: Implementation / Scope and evidence contract
pages.intro: Updated from the supplied 18-page v2.0 service guide. This revision describes actual code changes in source build 1.5.3-v45.7 and preserves visible implementation limits.
rows: 52 services + configuration
All 52 ordered service/product entries are registered as SVC-01…SVC-52. IP forwarding is CFG-IP-FORWARDING, an additional configuration family.
Scope and custom ports
Full TCP is default. Named catalog modes include 88 TCP ports; priority UDP includes 30 ports. Custom TCP/UDP ports add scope and can be configured per policy or locally.
Checks
Native Greenbone/OpenVAS feed performs protocol/product checks. This release adds routing/audit/evidence handling, not 52 independent custom vulnerability engines.
Credentials
Explicit local GMP UUIDs bind SSH, SMB, SNMP and ESXi credentials; optional SSH credential port is supported. Bound is distinct from successful authentication.
Evidence states
Family findings/observations require source references or native context. Missing evidence is not-tested; unsupported network collection is explicit. No pass is inferred from a quiet port.
Reporting
UI coverage detail; per-host 52-family CSV plus forwarding; JSON task policy audit; PDF/DOCX coverage appendix, including merged cases.
Live validation
Windows/Docker/Greenbone coverage/performance, credentialed product checks and raw Nessus parity still require real authorized target fixtures.

pages.title: Policy / Inputs, defaults and immutable audit
pages.intro: The central launch stores sanitized policy settings in orchestration_json. The claimed job receives this request; each created native task records what was actually applied.
rows: port_profile / mode
full (default), fast, common, vuln, nessus or nexus. All named non-Full modes retain the guide baseline and versioned catalog.
udp_profile
priority (default), full or off. Off removes UDP for every mode; Full requests 1–65535 UDP. Priority is additive baseline + transport extensions + existing catalog.
custom_tcp_ports / custom_udp_ports
Comma-separated ports/ranges or lists. Validate 1–65535, reject malformed/reversed/Boolean values. More than 4096 custom ports requires Full mode.
Local defaults
SCAN_TCP_CUSTOM_PORTS and SCAN_UDP_CUSTOM_PORTS. Legacy UDP_PORT_RANGE adds ports and cannot erase the baseline.
gmp_credential_refs
Only ssh/smb/snmp/esxi UUIDs. Local vault lookup/binding failure is recorded; unauthenticated detection continues. Raw passwords/URLs/tokens are dropped from transport.
ssh_credential_port
One validated port, default 22. Set it when an authorized SSH account is bound on a nonstandard port.
Task snapshot
Task/target/config/scanner IDs, effective/excluded port range and counts, guide version, feed versions, applied preferences, credential status, start time and SHA-256.
Resume

Persist snapshots immediately in progress; restore only policies whose entire target list belongs to this job. Old tasks without recorded policies stay unknown, not reconstructed from current defaults.

pages.title: UDP / Baseline, extensions and network collection
pages.intro: Numeric ports are not service counts. Priority scanning is explicit scope; UDP timeout/filtering is not a passed vulnerability test.
rows: Guide baseline (17)
Guide transport extensions (6)
88 Kerberos; 111 rpcbind; 389 CLDAP; 902 VMware; 2049 NFS; 3389 RDP.
Existing additional scope (7)
138 NetBIOS; 1701 L2TP; 1812/1813 RADIUS; 4789 VXLAN; 5004 RTP; 5060 SIP. Union gives 30 default priority UDP ports.
Full / Off
Full UDP requests all 65,535 ports. Off disables UDP without silently changing TCP. Custom additions respect the selected mode.
Network collector gap
DHCP discovery needs broadcast/relay/network scope. SSDP/mDNS may also need network-scoped discovery. No separate DHCP/SSDP/mDNS collector was added to the per-IP agent.
RPC / custom listeners
Full TCP covers dynamic/custom TCP numbers; Fast/catalog mode needs supplied additions for ports outside its named list. Native RPC enumeration depends on reachable services and feed support.
Printing boundary
JetDirect 9100 remains a listed endpoint. No custom raw printing payload was added. Native printer-check behavior must be validated on authorized fixtures.

pages.title: Reference findings / Eight guide families
pages.intro: These are labels and comparator cases from the supplied guide, not independently verified vulnerability declarations. Raw scanner/plugin evidence is required for exact parity.
headers: Evidence needed before a finding / parity claim
rows: SSLv2 / SSLv3
Protocol negotiation on the actual endpoint/SNI or STARTTLS context; record unsupported legacy runtime separately. Native feed evidence must identify the condition.
OpenSSH < 7.2 X11
Actual product version/build, enabled condition, vendor backport/advisory applicability, native plugin/CVE and source output.
Dropbear < 2016.72
Product/version plus applicable vendor advisory/build evidence; do not classify from TCP 22 alone.
SMB unprivileged shares
Share and permission evidence for the tested supplied user/access context, not merely an open SMB port.
SWEET32
Supported 64-bit block cipher negotiation and relevant endpoint context. Retain cipher and protocol evidence.
OpenSSH prior to 10.3 label
Treat the supplied export title as a comparison label. Obtain raw plugin/advisory/version applicability; do not invent a universal fixed version or severity.
Dropbear < 2013.59
Exact native plugin, product/build/version, vendor advisory/CVE and detection proof.
IP forwarding
Authenticated IPv4/IPv6 state and device-role policy, or verified native network evidence. Legitimate routing is not automatically a defect.
notes: Missing original material
The source guide notes that raw Nessus export/plugin IDs, CVEs, ports/vectors and policy details were absent. Exact accuracy/severity parity remains unverified.

pages.title: Evidence / States, confidence and score provenance
pages.intro: A native Done status is engine completion, not a universal pass for every service or authenticated configuration.
rows: Finding / observation
Positive native score with a matching source-backed family reference → finding; native context/reference without a scored condition → observation.
Missing / unsupported
No matching native evidence → not-tested. DHCP without network collection → unsupported. The family rollup does not imply independent per-check success.
Endpoint confidence
Port-only hints remain port_hint_only. Actual explicit service/product/CPE yields native_engine_context. No product/version is guessed from a default port.
Source identity
Result IDs, NVT OIDs/families, host, transport, port, supplied product/version/CPE and raw description remain linked. Central recomputes and scopes service rollups.
Scores
Finite numeric CVSS v2/v3/v4 candidates and raw native severity retained. Missing numeric score is marked score_available=false; it is distinct from a measured zero.
Severity
Central configured CVSS basis determines technical severity; default v3.1 bands use Critical ≥9, High ≥7, Medium ≥4, Low >0. Finding titles do not impose floors.
Contextual priority
Published custom weighted score is separate from native Tenable VPR. Native VPR/EPSS are preserved when supplied; missing threat data is not fabricated from CVSS.
Execution vs rule coverage

Host warnings/degraded port scans cannot become clean from partial=false. Family coverage_complete stays false unless actual rule success is established; a quiet report is not a 52-family clean certificate.

pages.title: Performance / Throughput and bounded recovery
pages.intro: The guide’s 15–18 IP/hour figure is a benchmark target, not a guaranteed three-minute scan. Preserve service scope and evidence while tuning hardware admission.
rows: Global IP capacity
Five-worker operational floor with adaptive ceiling (default up to six). Critical CPU/RAM/thermal pressure pauses new admissions; already running native tasks finish.
Per-IP engine budget
Separate one-host tasks. Honor configured checks (default eight, capped at sixteen), native VT timeout 320 s and scanner-plugin budget 36,000 s.
Discovery
Parallel connect probes are observational and do not narrow mandatory scope. No answering ports does not delete SSH/TLS or other target services.
Report harvest
Metadata first, paged native results; stable source-ID deduplication only. Parser/count/report failures remain visible instead of discarding low/informational evidence.
Progress
Complete assigned-IP snapshots with restored monotonic event sequence. Job row lock and owner fencing prevent overwrites or delayed previous-task regressions.
Capacity estimate
Throughput ≈ 60 × concurrent IPs / mean scan minutes. Five–six workers need roughly 16.7–24 mean minutes per IP for 15–18 IP/hour, assuming sustained workload and no overhead bottleneck.
Measure on target
Record feed/config/hash, per-IP runtime, CPU/RAM/thermal pressure, native row counts, timeout/plugin errors and credential gaps. Avoid lowering scope or forcing 100% to hit the rate.

Old source cleanup
Delivered packages exclude backup trees, caches, logs, compiled/dist dependencies, real scanner secrets and runtime identities. Current release files are authoritative.

pages.title: Validation / Completed and target-host acceptance
pages.intro: Source tests and document inspection are complete release checks. Live acquisition and scanner behavior require the real authorized hardware/network.
rows: Automated regressions

Guide scope/custom ports, UDP modes, invalid scope, secret filtering, credential references, immutable task audit, evidence routing, forwarding role, progress sequence, readiness launch and export/appendix fixtures. Final counts are in the release manifest.
Central integration
PostgreSQL-compatible WASM tests exercise migrations, heartbeat isolation, target ownership/exclusions and progress/severity SQL. TypeScript/Vite Vuln and Unified builds validate the UI.
Syntax / packages
Python 3.11 AST and changed PowerShell grammar checks; canonical agent JSON/Python parity; ZIP integrity and secret/cache exclusion; PDF bounds/bookmarks/text and visual review.
Windows / Greenbone
Run native PowerShell/Docker deploy and real feed-backed scans; confirm feed readiness, source version, all configured ports, dynamic/custom services and native errors.
All 52 families
Use authorized positive/negative/product-version/permission fixtures and supplied credentials. Match plugin IDs/CVEs and source evidence, not just port-open status.
Raw Nessus parity
Obtain the original scanner export and policy settings; compare exact host/port/product/plugin/vector/severity evidence before claiming parity.
Forensic live acceptance
Separate Disk/Mobile flow PDFs describe current source paths. Live phone/GPU verification remains pending; encrypted WhatsApp backups still require a matching validated key.
Known external gaps
No new DHCP/SSDP/mDNS network collector, dedicated IPv4/IPv6 configuration acquisition, per-SNI TLS cache/legacy engine, or independently validated 52-rule suite is claimed.
